工厂根据参数，定位对应的产品构造器。: Factory locates corresponding product constructor based on parameters.
调用方使用 brew()，不用再关心产品构造细节。: Caller uses brew() without needing to worry about product construction details.
在父类定义创建接口，让子类决定工作流程中使用的具体产品。: Define an interface in the parent class, allowing subclasses to decide the specific product used in the workflow.
等待 A 发起请求: Waiting for A to initiate request
A 请求时对象不存在，先创建实例 #1。: When A requests, instance #1 is created if it doesn't exist.
缓存已存在，B 直接得到 #1，A 和 B 指向同一个对象。: Cache exists, B directly gets #1; A and B point to the same object.
B → 复用 #1；A is B = True: B → Reuse #1; A is B = True
普通构造再次创建实例 #2，A 和 B 的引用不同。: Normal construction creates instance #2 again; A and B have different references.
B → 创建 #2；A is B = False: B → Create #2; A is B = False
在指定作用域内只创建一个实例，并复用同一个访问点。: Only one instance is created within a specified scope, and the same access point is reused.
多个调用方必须指向同一个对象，重复构造会造成状态分散。: Multiple callers must point to the same object; repeated creation leads to state dispersion.
确实需要进程内共享且生命周期明确的配置、注册表；先考虑显式依赖注入。: Configuration and registry that truly require process-level sharing and a clear lifetime; consider explicit dependency injection first.
跨进程唯一、分布式锁或数据库并发一致性；单例本身不能解决这些问题。: Unique across processes, distributed locks, or database concurrency consistency; Singleton alone cannot solve these issues.
隐藏的全局依赖增加测试隔离难度；懒初始化的并发访问需要同步。: Hidden global dependencies increase testing isolation difficulty; lazy initialization for concurrent access requires synchronization.
单例控制一种对象的实例数；享元按内在状态复用多种对象，并保留独立外部状态。: Singleton controls the number of instances of a single object; Fate reuses multiple objects based on internal state while retaining independent external state.
两个调用方申请同一个配置对象: Two callers request the same configuration object
箭头表示对象引用，不是网络请求；唯一性限于示例进程。: The arrow indicates an object reference, not a network request; uniqueness is limited to the example process.
先预测对象数量: Predict the number of objects first
两个调用方先后请求配置对象。两次调用会创建几个对象？: Two callers request the configuration object sequentially. How many objects will be created after two calls?
把按参数选择并创建产品的逻辑集中到一个入口。: Centralizes the logic of selecting and creating products based on parameters.
产品构造分支散落在调用方，新增产品时要到处修改。: Product construction branches are scattered across the caller, requiring modifications everywhere new products are added.
产品类型少且创建规则集中、变化可控的场景；简单函数通常足够。: Scenarios with few product types and centralized creation rules where changes are controllable; simple functions are usually sufficient.
产品族需要成套一致，或大量扩展需要由不同子类独立提供产品时。: When product families need to be consistent as a set, or when a large number of extensions require products to be provided independently by different subclasses.
调用方更简单，但集中分支会随产品增加而修改；它不属于 GoF 23 种。: The caller is simpler, but centralized branches will require modifications as products increase; it is not one of the 23 GoF patterns.
简单工厂在一个入口中选择产品；工厂方法由创建者的子类覆写创建步骤。: The Simple Factory selects a product at a single entry point; the Factory Method overwrites the creation steps by its creator's subclass.
按点单参数选择咖啡产品: Selecting coffee products based on order parameters
这里每次创建新产品；工厂也可以管理复用，但不是本例的重点。: A new product is created each time here; the factory can also manage reuse, but this is not the focus of this example.
客户端提供产品类型，构造细节集中在工厂函数。: The client provides the product type, with construction details concentrated in the factory function.
工厂的 button() 创建当前主题的按钮。: The factory's button() creates the button for the current theme.
浅色工厂 → 浅色按钮: Light Color Factory → Light Color Button
同一工厂的 menu() 返回配套菜单；产品族变化时替换整个工厂。: The same factory's menu() returns the supporting menu; the entire factory is replaced when the product family changes.
浅色按钮 + 浅色菜单；客户端流程不变: Light Color Button + Light Color Menu; client flow remains unchanged
通用业务流程需要创建产品，但产品类型应由扩展点决定。: General business processes require creating products, but product types should be determined by an extension point.
框架流程稳定，插件或子类需要替换其中的产品创建步骤。: The framework flow is stable; plugins or subclasses need to replace the product creation step.
只有一次简单构造、没有可复用流程或扩展需求时，直接构造更清楚。: When there is only a single simple construction and no reusable flow or extension needs, direct construction is clearer.
新增产品可以新增创建者子类，但产品与创建者类的数量也会增长。: A new product can have a new creator subclass, but the number of products and creator classes will also increase.
工厂方法关注一个创建扩展点；抽象工厂提供一组用于创建配套产品的方法。: The Factory Method focuses on a single creation extension point; the Abstract Factory provides a set of methods for creating associated products.
店铺子类决定 serve() 使用哪种咖啡: The store subclass determines which coffee to use in serve().
子类只替换创建步骤；客户端如何选择子类仍是外部配置的职责。: The subclass only replaces the creation step; the client's choice of subclass remains the responsibility of external configuration.
客户端持有具体店铺，但复用父类的 serve() 工作流程。: The client holds a specific store but reuses the parent class's serve() workflow.
父类调用工厂方法，具体子类返回对应产品。: The parent class calls the Factory Method, and a specific subclass returns the corresponding product.
通过同一个工厂创建一组相关产品，隔离具体产品族。: Create a set of related products through the same factory to isolate specific product families.
客户端需要配套的多类产品，混搭具体实现容易破坏一致性。: Clients need a variety of complementary products; mixing specific implementations can easily break consistency.
同一平台的按钮与菜单、同一数据库族的连接与命令等成套切换。: Buttons and menus on the same platform, connections and commands for the same database family, etc., should be switched as a set.
只创建一种产品，或各产品之间没有配套关系时。: Only create one product type, or when there is no complementary relationship between products.
新增产品族方便；新增产品种类需要修改工厂接口及所有具体工厂。: Adding a new product family is convenient; adding a new product type requires modifying the factory interface and all specific factories.
抽象工厂切换一整套配套产品；工厂方法通常替换父类流程中的某个创建步骤。: Abstract factory switches a complete set of complementary products; factory method usually replaces a certain creation step in the parent class flow.
同一主题工厂生产按钮与菜单: Buttons and menus are produced by the same theme factory
配套一致来自客户端使用同一工厂；模式不会自动阻止外部手动混搭。: Complementary products come from the same client using the same factory; the pattern does not automatically prevent external manual mixing.
把一个具体工厂交给客户端；按钮和菜单来自同一主题族。: Hand over a specific factory to the client; buttons and menus come from the same theme family.
桌面是尚未加入成品的原料；Builder 此时为空。调用方决定按配方加入哪几层。: The desktop is an ingredient not yet added to the finished product; the Builder is currently empty. The caller decides which layers to add according to the recipe.
第 1 步把面包加入当前产品；同一个构建器可以选择不同配方。: Step 1: Add bread to the current product; the same builder can choose different recipes.
第 2 步把芝士加入当前产品；同一个构建器可以选择不同配方。: Step 2: Add cheese to the current product; the same builder can choose different recipes.
对象含文件句柄、锁或外部连接时，需要明确复制语义，不能直接假定 deepcopy: When an object contains a file handle, lock, or external connection, the semantics must be explicitly copied; you cannot directly assume that a deep copy is correct.
减少重复初始化，但必须决定哪些嵌套状态共享，哪些递归复制；复制不保证一定更快。: Reduce redundant initialization, but you must decide which nested states to share and which to recursively copy; copying is not guaranteed to be faster.
原型从已有对象复制；建造者从构建步骤逐步得到对象。: A prototype copies from an existing object; a builder constructs the object step by step from building steps.
复制文档后修改嵌套标签列表: Modify the nested label list after copying the document.
展示普通可复制 Python 对象；自定义复制协议或外部资源可能需要特别处理。: Display a regular, copyable Python object; custom copying protocols or external resources may require special handling.
深色按钮 + 深色菜单；客户端流程不变: Dark button + Dark menu; client flow remains unchanged
把复杂产品拆成构建步骤，用不同步骤组合生成不同表示。: Break down complex products into building steps, combining different steps to generate different representations.
构造参数过多或步骤有依赖，一次构造很难表达过程和不同配方。: Too many parameters or dependencies between steps make it hard to express the process and different recipes in a single construction.
复杂请求、文档或套餐需要分步构建，同一流程可生成不同产品表示。: Complex requests, documents, or packages need step-by-step construction, allowing different product representations for the same process.
只有几个独立参数时，普通构造器、命名参数或 dataclass 通常更直接。: For a few independent parameters, a regular constructor, named parameters, or dataclass are usually more direct.
过程更清晰，但增加构建器；必须明确取出产品后的复用与重置规则。: The process is clearer, but it adds a builder; reuse and reset rules after product extraction must be clearly defined.
建造者逐步组装一个复杂产品；抽象工厂创建多个彼此配套的产品。: The builder assembles a complex product step by step; an abstract factory creates multiple complementary products.
按步骤搭建不同层数的套餐: Build different layered packages step by step
实体层代表已加入的产品部分，不是 Python 的内存布局；链式调用本身不等于建: The entity layer represents the product parts that have been added, not Python's memory layout; chain calls themselves do not equal a builder.
build() 返回完整产品的副本，并重置构建器，避免下一次继续使用旧内容。: build() returns a copy of the complete product and resets the builder to avoid using old content next time.
仅创建新的顶层对象，嵌套标签列表仍被共享。: Only create a new top-level object; nested tags are still shared.
副本追加“已审”时，两个对象都看到共享列表发生变化。: When a copy is added with 'Reviewed', both objects see the shared list change.
第 3 步把番茄加入当前产品；同一个构建器可以选择不同配方。: Step 3: Add tomato to the current product; the same builder can choose different recipes.
以已有对象为原型复制新对象，再调整副本。: Create a new object by copying an existing one, then adjust the copy.
初始化复杂或具体类型不宜暴露，但需要创建结构相似的对象。: It's not advisable to expose complex or specific types during initialization, but creating objects with similar structures is necessary.
文档模板、编辑器图元、复杂配置等需要按已有实例复制。: Document templates, editor components, complex configurations, etc., need to be copied from existing instances.
共享引用：原型与副本同时观察到变化: Shared Reference: Prototype and Copy observe changes simultaneously
递归复制嵌套列表，副本得到独立的标签列表。: Recursive copy of nested lists, with the copy getting an independent tag list.
向副本追加“已审”；原型标签仍然只有“草稿”。: Add 'Reviewed' to the copy; the prototype's tag remains only 'Draft'.
把现有对象的接口转换成客户端需要的接口。: Converts the existing object's interface into what the client needs.
已有功能能完成工作，但方法名、参数或返回形态与目标接口不一致。: Existing functionality can complete the task, but method names, parameters, or return types don't match the target interface.
接入旧库、第三方 SDK 或协议迁移；把转换限制在明确边界内。: Integrating old libraries, third-party SDKs, or protocols for migration; limits the conversion to clear boundaries.
双方语义根本不兼容时，改方法名无法解决业务契约差异。: When the semantics of both sides are completely incompatible, changing the method name won't resolve the business contract differences.
复用旧实现，但增加转发层；参数、错误与返回值的语义也需要适配。: Reusing old implementation but adding a forwarding layer; parameters, errors, and return values also need semantic adaptation.
适配器补齐已有接口的不兼容；桥接在设计时拆开两个独立变化维度。: Adapter fills in the incompatibilities of existing interfaces; bridge separates two independent change dimensions during design.
把旧 push() 接口接入新的 send() 客户端: Connects the old push() interface to the new send() client
本例只需要转换方法名；实际适配可能还需转换参数、返回值与错误。: This example only needs to change the method name; actual adaptation may also require changing parameters, return values, and errors.
新客户端调用 send()，旧库只暴露 push()。: New client calls send(), while the old library only exposes push().
已有文档包含一个可变的嵌套列表 tags。: Existing documentation includes a mutable nested list of tags.
客户端和旧库的方法名不同: Client and Old Library Method Names Are Different
对象适配器持有旧库对象，将 send(text) 转发成 push(text)。: Object Adapter Holds Old Library Object, Forward send(text) to push(text).
客户端仍使用自己的目标接口，旧库代码不用改。: Client Still Uses Its Own Target Interface, Old Library Code Needs No Changes.
切换通道只替换 Sender；通知级别的封装逻辑保持不变。: Switch channel only replaces Sender; notification level encapsulation logic remains unchanged.
通知抽象加上“紧急”前缀，具体实现负责实际发送。: Add 'Urgent' prefix to notification abstraction, specific implementation handles actual sending.
高度仅表示树的层级；连线表示包含关系，不表示调用耗时或内存距离。: Height only represents tree level; lines indicate containment, not call time or memory distance.
订单与单品都提供 total()，客户端不用逐个判断是否为容器。: Both orders and items provide total(), clients don't need to check if each is a container.
根订单分别向咖啡和蛋糕委托 total()。: Root orders delegate total() to coffee and cake respectively.
叶节点返回自身金额，容器返回子项金额之和，任意深度遵守同一接口。: Leaf nodes return their own amount, containers return the sum of sub-item amounts, and all depths adhere to the same interface.
直接向旧对象调用 send() 会找不到方法；数据还没有送出。: Calling send() directly on the old object will result in a method not found; the data has not been sent yet.
缺少适配器时不能完成本次目标接口调用。: The target interface call cannot be completed without an adapter.
将抽象与实现分开，通过组合让两个维度独立变化。: Separate the abstraction from the implementation, allowing the two dimensions to vary independently through composition.
两个变化维度全部用继承组合，子类数量会按组合数量增长。: Both variation dimensions are handled via inheritance and composition, so the number of subclasses will grow with the number of compositions.
通知级别 × 发送通道、图形 × 渲染后端等确有两个独立变化轴。: There are indeed two independent variation axes: notification level × sending channel, and graphics × rendering backend.
只有一个变化维度时，不必预设第二个接口层。: When there is only one variation dimension, no second interface layer needs to be pre-defined.
组合避免继承组合爆炸，但接口分层与对象配置更复杂。: Composition avoids the explosion of inheritance, but interface layering and object configuration become more complex.
桥接主动设计独立演化的抽象和实现；适配器包装已有不兼容接口。: Bridge design proactively creates independent variations for abstractions and implementations; adapters wrap existing incompatible interfaces.
紧急通知跨过发送接口，切换短信或邮件实现: Emergency notification bypasses the sending interface and switches to SMS or email implementation
箭头表示持有并委托实现；示例只模拟发送，不产生网络请求。: The arrow indicates holding and delegating implementation; the example only simulates sending and does not generate network requests.
通知级别与发送通道分别定义，通过组合连接，而不是为每种组合创建子类。: Notification level and sending channel are defined separately and connected via composition, rather than creating subclasses for each combination.
用统一接口表示叶节点与容器，递归处理树形整体。: Use a unified interface to represent leaf nodes and containers, recursively processing the entire tree structure.
部分与整体嵌套成树，调用方不想为单项和分组维护两套处理代码。: Part and whole are nested into a tree; the caller does not want to maintain two separate sets of processing code for individual items and groups.
文件目录、组织结构、菜单与订单分组等具有递归部分整体关系的数据。: Data such as file directories, organizational structures, menus, and order groups with recursive relationships.
需要严格限制不同节点可执行的操作时，要避免一个过宽的统一接口。: When strictly limiting the operations that different nodes can perform, avoid an overly broad unified interface.
递归调用简单，但需要维护无环树与节点所有权；叶子不一定适合所有容器操作。: Recursive calls are simple, but maintaining a cycle-free tree and node ownership is required; leaves may not be suitable for all container operations.
组合通常聚合多个子项，表达树；装饰器通常包裹单个组件，逐层增强行为。: A combination typically aggregates multiple sub-items to represent a tree; a decorator usually wraps a single component to enhance behavior layer by layer.
订单分组形成可递归汇总的层次树: Order groups form a hierarchical tree that can be recursively summarized.
外层先调用内层，最终到达原始咖啡对象。: Outer layer calls inner layer first, eventually reaching the original coffee object.
内层结果逐层返回，每个包装器增加自己的行为或费用。: Inner layer results are returned layer by layer, with each wrapper adding its own behavior or cost.
门面根据任务按顺序调用播放器、屏幕、灯光；它们仍可独立使用。: Facade calls player, screen, and lights in order based on task; they can still be used independently.
门面简化了入口和调用顺序，没有替代子系统自身的职责。: Facade simplifies entry points and call order without replacing the subsystems' own responsibilities.
同一字形 A 出现在三个位置: same character A appears at three positions
按 (字符, 字体) 查询池，三次请求复用一个不可变样式对象。: query pool by (character, font), reuses immutable style object for three requests.
共享样式不包含位置；同一份内在状态可以在不同位置绘制。: shared style does not include position; the same internal state can be drawn at different positions.
本例省去样式副本: style copies are omitted in this example
为复杂子系统提供一个面向任务的简化入口。: Provides a task-oriented simplified entry point for complex subsystems.
客户端需要记住多个子系统和调用顺序，耦合到过多细节。: Clients need to remember multiple subsystems and call orders, leading to excessive coupling.
为常用流程提供稳定入口，例如初始化、结账或一键开启影院。: Provides a stable entry point for common workflows, such as initialization, checkout, or one-click cinema access.
不要把所有业务塞进一个全能门面；跨服务事务也不会因此自动保证。: Don't pack all business logic into a single all-purpose facade; cross-service transactions won't be automatically guaranteed by this.
降低客户端耦合，但门面要保持职责集中，避免变成巨型类。: Reduces client coupling, but the facade must keep its responsibilities focused to avoid becoming a giant class.
外观面向一个子系统提供简化的新接口；代理通常保持目标接口并控制访问。: The facade provides a simplified new interface for a subsystem; the proxy usually maintains the target interface and controls access.
一次观影操作协调灯光、屏幕和播放器: Coordinates lighting, screen, and player for a single viewing operation.
仅展示成功路径与协调顺序，不包含失败回滚；门面不会自动提供事务。: Only shows the successful path and coordinated sequence, without failure rollback; the facade doesn't automatically provide transactions.
客户端把完整用例交给门面，不必知道每个子系统的调用细节。: Clients pass the complete use case to the facade without needing to know the call details of each subsystem.
共享不可变的内在状态，把每次使用的外部状态单独传入。: share immutable internal state, passing external state separately for each use.
大量细粒度对象有重复的大块状态，重复存储造成开销。: Many fine-grained objects have redundant large states, and repeated storage causes overhead.
字形、棋子样式、地图纹理等重复状态多、共享价值明确的场景。: Scenarios with many redundant states for characters, piece styles, map textures, etc., where shared value is clear.
对象很少、共享查找成本更高，或共享状态必须频繁独立修改时。: Few objects, higher shared lookup costs, or when shared state must be frequently and independently modified.
节省重复状态，但要维护共享池，严格隔离位置等外部状态并控制池生命周期。: Save redundant states, but maintain a shared pool, strictly isolate external states like position, and control the pool's lifecycle.
享元允许按键存在多份共享实例；单例约束指定作用域中的单一实例。: Flyweights allow multiple shared instances of a button; Singleton enforces a single instance within its scope.
三个字符位置引用同一份内在样式: Three-character positions reference the same internal style.
对象数是本例计算值，不是内存字节数；节省的是重复样式，位置上下文仍然各自存在。: The number of objects is the value calculated for this example, not memory bytes; what is saved is redundant styles, while position contexts still exist independently.
字符 A 和字体是可共享的内在状态；每次出现的位置是独立的外部状态。: Character A and font are shared internal states; each position they appear in is an independent external state.
代理与真实对象都提供 read()，客户端先访问代理。: Both the proxy and the real object provide read(); the client first accesses the proxy.
检查通过，才把调用转交给真实对象。: Only if passed, the call is forwarded to the real object.
观察真实对象是否执行: Observe if the real object is executed
真实文件被读取一次，结果经代理返回客户端。: The real file is read once, and the result is returned to the client via the proxy.
draw(style, x, y) → 三个独立位置: draw(style, x, y) → three separate positions
没有样式池，每次出现都重新构造同样的内在状态。: No style pool; same internal state is recreated each time.
通过保持目标接口的替身控制对真实对象的访问。: Control access to the real object through a substitute for the target interface.
直接访问对象不方便或不允许，需要鉴权、延迟加载、缓存或远程转发。: Direct access to the object is inconvenient or prohibited; authentication, lazy loading, caching, or remote forwarding is required.
保护代理、虚拟代理和远程代理；代理与真实对象遵守同一调用契约。: Protect proxies, virtual proxies, and remote proxies; proxies and real objects adhere to the same call contract.
只想对多个子系统提供更简单的操作入口时，属于外观的主要目的。: This is the main purpose of a facade when providing simpler operation entry points for multiple subsystems.
访问策略集中，但增加一层间接调用；远程失败、缓存一致性等仍需单独处理。: Access strategy is centralized, but an additional layer of indirect calls is added; remote failures, cache consistency, etc., still need separate handling.
代理决定是否、何时、怎样到达目标；装饰器强调在目标行为之外叠加功能。: The proxy decides whether, when, and how to reach the target; decorators emphasize adding functionality outside the target behavior.
鉴权代理决定是否访问真实文件: An authenticated proxy decides whether to access the real file
权限为教学用布尔值；实际系统不能让调用方自行声明可信权限。: Permission is a boolean for educational purposes; the actual system cannot allow the caller to declare their own trusted permissions.
请求进入链头: Request to enter the chain head
报销 400 元；调用方只提交给组长，不指定最终处理人。: Reimbursement of 400 yuan; the caller only submits to the Team lead, without specifying the final handler.
只从第一个处理者开始: Start from the first handler only
链中每个节点只了解自身条件和下一个节点；调用方不做额度分流。: Each node in the chain only knows its own conditions and the next node; the caller does not distribute the limit.
额度足够，组长完成审批，后续节点不再处理。: The limit is sufficient; the Team lead completes the approval, and subsequent nodes will not process it anymore.
检查失败，代理直接返回拒绝结果，不触达真实对象。: Check failed: proxy directly returns a denial result without invoking the real object.
真实文件保持未访问，结果在代理处结束。: The real file remains unaccessed; the result ends at the proxy.
真实对象没有执行: The real object was not executed.
把请求沿处理链传递，由能够处理的节点接手。: Pass the request along the processing chain, with the node that can handle it taking over.
提交方不应写死审批人，处理规则和顺序却会随业务变化。: The submitter should not hardcode the approver; processing rules and order will change with business needs.
分级审批、逐级匹配处理器；发送方无需知道最终接收者。: Hierarchical approval, matching processors step by step; the sender doesn't need to know the final recipient.
每个步骤都必须执行且顺序固定时，普通流水线通常更直接。: When each step must be executed in a fixed order, a simple pipeline is usually more direct.
链顺序影响结果；请求可能无人处理，需要定义链尾语义。: The chain order affects the result; a request might go unprocessed, requiring definition of the chain's end semantics.
责任链寻找处理者，节点可终止传递；装饰器层层叠加职责并委托被包装对象。: The Chain of Responsibility finds a processor; nodes can terminate the pass. Decorators stack responsibilities and delegate to the wrapped object.
报销单穿过审批链: The reimbursement form passes through the approval chain.
这里采用首个能处理者终止的链；某些责任链会让多个节点继续处理。额度是教学参数。: This uses the chain that terminates with the first available processor; some Chain of Responsibility chains will have multiple nodes continue processing. The quota is a teaching parameter.
根订单调用单品和套餐的 total()，套餐再向下委托。: Root order calls the total() of both the single item and the package, with the package delegating further down.
保持组件接口，用持有组件的包装器逐层增加行为。: Maintain component interfaces and add behavior layer by layer using a wrapper that holds the components.
功能可以多种组合且要按对象动态添加，继承难覆盖所有组合。: Functions can be combined in various ways and need to be dynamically added by object, making inheritance difficult to cover all combinations.
I/O 流、日志、压缩、计费附加项等可组合的增强操作。: I/O streams, logs, compression, billing add-ons, and other combinable enhancements.
只是控制能否访问一个对象时，应优先按代理的目的来理解。: When controlling access to an object, the priority should be to understand it based on the proxy's purpose.
undo 用执行前快照实现；只撤销最近一次且无并发修改的操作。外部不可逆动作不一: undo uses a snapshot before execution; only the most recent operation without concurrent changes is reversed. External irreversible actions may not be reversible.
把请求封装为对象: Encapsulate the request into an object
Insert 保存接收者和要插入的文本；创建命令时尚未执行。: Insert saves the receiver and the text to be inserted; the command is not yet executed.
调用者只调用 execute；命令再调用文档的方法。: The caller only calls execute; the command then calls the document's method.
命令显式恢复旧值: Command explicitly restores the old value
报销 4000 元；调用方只提交给组长，不指定最终处理人。: Reimbursement of 4000 yuan; the caller only submits it to the Team lead, without specifying a final handler.
额度不足；当前节点把同一请求交给下一节点。: Balance insufficient; the current node passes the same request to the next node.
额度足够，总监完成审批，后续节点不再处理。: Balance sufficient; the Director completes the approval, and subsequent nodes no longer process it.
把一次请求连同接收者和参数封装成对象。: Encapsulate a single request along with the receiver and parameters into an object.
按钮与业务操作绑在一起，就难以统一排队、记录或撤销。: Buttons are tied to business operations, making it difficult to unify queuing, logging, or cancellation.
编辑器操作、任务队列、宏命令，需要把触发时机和执行逻辑分开。: Editor operations, task queues, and macro commands require separating the trigger time from the execution logic.
只是立即调用一个简单函数时，额外的命令类未必有收益。: When only a simple function is called immediately, an additional command class may not be beneficial.
命令数量会增加；undo、重试与持久化都需要额外设计，不由模式自动提供。: The number of commands will increase; undo, retry, and persistence require additional design, not automatically provided by the pattern.
命令代表一次带参数的请求；策略代表可替换的算法，通常会被上下文重复使用。: A command represents a single request with parameters; a strategy represents a replaceable algorithm, typically reused by the context.
可排队、可撤销的文档插入: Document insertion that can be queued and canceled
undo 恢复 execute 之前保存的文字。撤销能力需要命令自行实现。: undo restores the text saved before execution. The undo capability must be implemented by the command itself.
两个命令可以先保存，稍后由同一调用者触发。: two commands can be saved first and triggered later by the same caller.
依次执行两个请求，文档得到 AB；接收者不需要知道队列。: execute the two requests in sequence, and the document gets AB; the receiver doesn't need to know the queue.
用表达式对象表示语法规则，递归解释组合而成的句子。: uses an expression object to represent grammatical rules and recursively interpret composed sentences.
业务规则像一门小语言，直接堆条件分支会难以组合和求值。: business rules are like a small language; directly using conditionals and branches would be difficult to combine and evaluate.
语法简单且稳定的小型规则语言、表达式树。: simple and stable small rule language with expression trees.
复杂通用语言应考虑成熟解析器；不要把不可信字符串交给 eval。: for complex general-purpose languages, consider a mature parser; don't pass untrusted strings to eval.
每条规则往往对应一个类；语法复杂时类数量和解析成本都会上升。: each rule often corresponds to a class; complex syntax increases the number of classes and parsing costs.
组合表达树形整体与部分；解释器常借助组合树，但额外定义语法规则和求值语义。: composes expression trees as a whole and parts; the interpreter often uses the composite tree, but also defines additional grammatical rules and evaluation semantics.
组合灵活，但调用层次增加；包装顺序可能改变结果和调试路径。: Composites are flexible, but the call hierarchy increases; wrapping order may change the result and debugging path.
装饰器着重叠加行为；代理着重控制访问，二者可能具有相似的包装结构。: Decorators focus on stacking behavior; proxies focus on controlling access, and the two may have similar wrapping structures.
外层费用包装器调用内层，再逐层返回加价结果: The outer cost wrapper calls the inner one, then returns the premium result layer by layer.
直接构造语法树，未实现字符串词法分析或解析器；树的层级已经明确运算关系。: Directly construct the syntax tree, with string tokenization or parser not implemented; the tree's hierarchy already clearly indicates the operation relationships.
每种语法规则对应一种表达式对象；树的层级表示组合关系。: Each grammar rule corresponds to an expression object; the tree's hierarchy represents the combination relationship.
两个 Number 直接返回自身的数值 2 和 3。: Two Numbers directly return their values 2 and 3.
根节点执行加法并返回 5；增加语法规则会增加相应的表达式类。: The root node performs addition and returns 5; adding a grammar rule increases the corresponding expression class.
Add 先得到左值 2，再递归解释 Multiply；后者得到 3 × 4 =: Add first gets the L-value 2, then recursively interprets Multiply; the latter yields 3 × 4 = 12.
根节点执行加法并返回 14；增加语法规则会增加相应的表达式类。: The root node performs addition and returns 14; adding a grammar rule increases the corresponding expression class.
分层是展开的调用嵌套示意；本例加价可交换，但其他装饰操作未必可以交换顺序。: Layered structure represents nested calls; in this example, the price can be swapped, but other decoration operations may not have interchangeable order.
各层都暴露 cost()，外层持有内层；这里的分层表示调用嵌套。: Each layer exposes cost(), with the outer layer holding the inner one; this layering represents call nesting.
第 1 次 next 返回 A。集合本身保持不变，游标向前推进。: first next returns A. The collection remains unchanged, and the cursor advances.
第 2 次 next 返回 B。集合本身保持不变，游标向前推进。: second next returns B. The collection remains unchanged, and the cursor advances.
第 3 次 next 返回 C。再调用一次将触发 StopIteration。: third next returns C. Another call will trigger StopIteration.
第 1 次 next 返回 C。集合本身保持不变，游标向前推进。: first next returns C. The collection remains unchanged, and the cursor advances.
第 3 次 next 返回 A。再调用一次将触发 StopIteration。: third next returns A. Another call will trigger StopIteration.
通过统一接口顺序访问集合，而不暴露内部存储方式。: Accesses the collection via a unified interface order without exposing internal storage methods.
调用方直接依赖索引和存储结构，换成树或流时遍历代码就要重写。: The caller directly depends on the index and storage structure; rewriting traversal code would be required if switched to a tree or stream.
集合有多种遍历方式，或需要惰性产生元素、维护独立游标。: Collections have multiple traversal methods, or may need lazy element generation and independent cursors.
Python 的 for、生成器和内建迭代器已经够用时，优先直接使用。: Python's for, generators, and built-in iterators are sufficient and should be used directly first.
需要定义遍历期间修改集合的行为；一次性迭代器耗尽后不会自动重来。: Must define behavior for modifying the collection during traversal; it does not automatically repeat after a one-time iteration is exhausted.
迭代器决定如何逐个取元素；访问者决定对不同类型元素执行什么操作。: The iterator determines how elements are taken one by one; the visitor determines what operations to perform on different element types.
集合不动，游标改变访问顺序: The collection remains static, but the cursor changes the access order.
用固定集合展示正向与逆向遍历；不演示遍历中修改集合、并发或无限流。: Displays forward and reverse traversal with a fixed collection; does not demonstrate modifying the collection during traversal, concurrency, or infinite streams.
遍历方式由迭代器封装；调用方使用同一种 next 协议。: Traversal method is encapsulated by the iterator; the caller uses the same next protocol.
任一输入变化都交给中介者；校验规则集中在协调者里。: Any input change is passed to the mediator; validation rules are concentrated in the coordinator.
即使邮箱有效，姓名为空仍使按钮禁用。: Even if the email is valid, the button remains disabled if the name is empty.
让多个组件通过一个协调者协作，减少彼此直接依赖。: Allows multiple components to collaborate through a single coordinator, reducing direct dependencies between them.
表单中的输入框和按钮互相调用，组件数量一多就形成关系网。: Form input fields and buttons call each other, forming a network of relationships as the number of components grows.
表单联动、对话框控件、参与者之间有明确的集中协调规则。: Form linking, dialog box controls, and participants have clear centralized coordination rules.
独立组件之间没有协作规则时，不需要为了集中而集中。: When independent components lack collaboration rules, centralization for its own sake is unnecessary.
关系复杂性集中到中介者；规则过多会使它变成难维护的巨型对象。: Complexity of relationships is concentrated in the mediator; too many rules turn it into a large, hard-to-maintain object.
中介者封装多方的协作规则；观察者传播一个主题的变化，通常不负责整体协调。: The mediator encapsulates coordination rules for multiple parties; the observer propagates changes in a topic and is not typically responsible for overall coordination.
输入组件通过表单协调者更新按钮: Input components update buttons through the form coordinator
邮箱校验仅用 @ 示意业务条件，不是完整校验器；中介者不等同网络消息代理。: Email validation only uses @ to indicate business conditions, not a complete validator; the mediator is not equivalent to a network message proxy.
组件只认识协调者: The component only recognizes the coordinator
输入框和按钮不直接相互调用；它们共享同一个中介者。: Input fields and buttons do not directly call each other; they share the same mediator.
Editor 负责封装快照；History 只保存它，不读取或修改内部内容。: Editor is responsible for encapsulating the snapshot; History only saves it, without reading or modifying internal content.
当前状态改变，之前的快照保持不变。: Current state changes, previous snapshot remains unchanged.
由 Editor 读取自己的快照，恢复为 A；不是逐条执行操作的逆过程。: Editor reads its own snapshot to restore to A; this is not the reverse process of executing operations one by one.
两个条件同时成立，中介者启用按钮。: Both conditions are met; the mediator enables the button.
在保持封装的前提下保存对象状态，供以后恢复。: Save the object's state for later restoration while maintaining encapsulation.
历史管理器需要撤回状态，却不应掌握对象内部所有字段。: The history manager needs to revert the state but should not have access to all internal fields of the object.
编辑器快照、游戏存档、对象状态回滚。: Editor snapshot, game save, object state rollback.
状态很大且变化很频繁时，完整快照可能比增量操作记录更昂贵。: When the state is large and changes frequently, a full snapshot may be more expensive than incremental logging.
占用存储；快照必须独立于后续修改，还要定义保存粒度与保留期限。: Consumes storage; snapshots must be independent of subsequent modifications, and save granularity and retention period must be defined.
备忘录保存“当时是什么”；命令保存“要做什么”。命令的撤销也可以借助备忘录。: Memento saves “what it was at the time”; command saves “what to do”. Command reversal can also use Memento.
同一次恢复，取决于保存时刻: Same restoration depends on the save time
以不可变字符串快照示意封装；Python 下划线是访问约定。可变嵌套状态要额外处: Encapsulated by an immutable string snapshot; Python uses underscores for access conventions. Variable nested states require extra handling for copying.
文档当前为 A。保存的时机决定以后能回到哪个版本。: The document is currently A. The save time determines which version can be restored later.
主题发布一个变化: Publish a change for the subject
主题遍历当前订阅列表，调用统一的 update 接口。: Traverse the current subscription list and call the unified update interface.
同一个变化触发三个观察者。各观察者可自行决定如何响应。: The same change triggers three observers. Each observer can decide how to respond independently.
文档当前为 AB。保存的时机决定以后能回到哪个版本。: The document is currently in AB. The save timing determines which version can be restored later.
由 Editor 读取自己的快照，恢复为 AB；不是逐条执行操作的逆过程。: The Editor reads its own snapshot and reverts to AB; this is not the reverse process of executing operations one by one.
主题变化时，通知当前注册的多个观察者。: When the topic changes, notify all currently registered observers.
新增通知渠道不应迫使主题依赖每一种具体接收者。: Adding new notification channels should not force the topic to depend on every specific receiver.
UI 数据绑定、领域事件、同一变化需要触发多种独立响应。: UI data binding, domain events, and the same change should trigger multiple independent responses.
只有一个固定调用目标时，直接调用更清楚；需要可靠投递时应另设计消息机制。: When there is only one fixed target to call, calling it directly is clearer; a separate message mechanism should be designed for reliable delivery.
要管理订阅生命周期、防止重复订阅和通知环；通知顺序、异步性与失败隔离需显式约定。: Manage subscription lifecycle, prevent duplicate subscriptions and notification loops; explicit conventions are needed for notification order, asynchronous behavior, and failure isolation.
观察者强调一对多变化通知；中介者集中封装多个参与者之间的协作规则。: Observers emphasize one-to-many change notifications; intermediaries centralize encapsulation of collaboration rules between multiple participants.
文章发布触发当前订阅者: Article publication triggers the current subscriber
经典直接通知的观察者模型；箭头不表示并行或可靠投递，也不把所有异步 Pub/Su: Classic observer model with direct notifications; arrows do not indicate parallel or reliable delivery, nor do they equate all asynchronous Pub/Sub with this pattern.
主题保存观察者引用；观察者可以注册，也可以主动取消。: The topic saves observer references; observers can register or actively unsubscribe.
邮件与短信收到事件，App 不再收到；无需修改主题的发布逻辑。: Event for receiving emails and SMS; App will no longer receive them. No changes needed to the topic publishing logic.
把与状态有关的行为交给状态对象，让同一请求产生不同反应。: Pass behavior related to the status to the status object, allowing different responses for the same request.
对象每个方法都在重复检查 status，合法转换规则散落在条件分支里。: Each method of the object repeatedly checks the status, with valid conversion rules scattered across conditional branches.
订单、文档、播放器等有清晰状态和转换规则的对象。: Objects like orders, documents, and players have clear statuses and conversion rules.
只有少量稳定状态且行为简单时，枚举加条件判断可能更易读。: For a small number of stable states with simple behavior, using enums with conditionals may be more readable.
增加状态类；必须明确谁负责转换，避免上下文和状态对象互相争夺规则。: Add a status class; clearly define who is responsible for the conversion to prevent the context and status objects from competing for rules.
状态描述对象当前所处阶段，事件可推动内部转换；策略通常由外部选择可替换算法。: The status description object represents its current stage; events can trigger internal conversions; strategies are usually external choices for replaceable algorithms.
稿件由当前状态决定能否审核: Whether a draft can be reviewed depends on its current status.
仅演示三种状态和两个事件；转换规则是示例业务，并非状态模式要求的固定流程。: Only demonstrates three states and two events; conversion rules are example business logic, not the fixed process required by the state pattern.
上下文持有当前状态: The context holds the current status
同一个 approve 请求交给当前状态处理；起始状态是 Draft。: The same approve request is handled by the current status; the initial state is Draft.
Draft.submit 把上下文的状态切换为 Review。: Draft.submit switches the context's state to Review.
Review.approve 切换为 Published；状态对象决定合法转换。: Review.approve switches to Published; the state object determines the valid transition.
普通算法计算 2 × 5；结算流程不需要知道公式细节。: Normal algorithm calculates 2 × 5; the settlement process doesn't need to know the formula details.
运费为 ¥10；切换策略不会自动触发另一策略或改变上下文状态。: Shipping fee is ¥10; switching strategies won't automatically trigger another strategy or change the context state.
运费为 ¥25；切换策略不会自动触发另一策略或改变上下文状态。: Shipping fee is ¥25; switching strategies won't automatically trigger another strategy or change the context state.
在基类固定算法骨架，把可变步骤留给子类实现。: In the base class's fixed algorithm skeleton, leave variable steps for subclasses to implement.
多个导入器重复相同流程，只有解析方式存在差异。: Multiple importers repeat the same process, only the parsing method differs.
处理步骤和顺序稳定，但少数步骤会随具体类型变化。: Processing steps and order are stable, but a few steps vary with specific types.
步骤组合经常在运行时改变时，组合或策略通常更灵活。: When step combinations frequently change at runtime, combinations or strategies are usually more flexible.
子类与基类骨架耦合；子类不应随意覆盖模板方法来破坏顺序。: Subclasses are coupled with the base class skeleton; subclasses shouldn't arbitrarily override template methods to disrupt the order.
模板方法把变化点留在继承层次；策略把算法作为对象或函数注入上下文。: Template methods leave changes at the inheritance level; strategies inject algorithms as objects or functions into the context.
导入器共享骨架，仅替换解析步骤: Shared skeleton for importer, only replacing parsing steps
read 和 save 在最小示例中只返回数据，不做真实文件或数据库操作；骨架顺: read and save in the minimal example only return data, no real file or database operations; the skeleton order can be checked directly.
基类 run 规定 read → parse → save；子类只覆盖解析步骤。: Base class run specifies read → parse → save; subclasses only override the parsing step.
读取一段 JSON 文本，还没有解析成记录。: Reading a JSON text string that has not yet been parsed into a record.
JSONImporter 用 JSON 解析器得到字典列表。: JSONImporter uses a JSON parser to get a list of dictionaries.
调用方需要了解算法差异；在 Python 中策略可直接使用函数，不必强建类层次。: The caller needs to understand the algorithm differences; in Python, strategies can directly use functions without needing to build a class hierarchy.
策略通过组合替换算法；模板方法通过继承替换固定骨架中的步骤。: Strategies replace algorithms through composition; the Template Method replaces steps in a fixed skeleton through inheritance.
同一个结算流程，换一种运费算法: The same payment process, but with a different shipping fee algorithm.
当前 Draft 不接受审核通过事件；状态保持 Draft。: Current Draft does not accept approval events; status remains Draft.
合法提交后进入 Review: After a valid submission, it enters Review
